description:
# Experience Tall Ships from the Water: 90-Minute Harbor Cruise on Patriot

Step aboard Patriot, a charming classic wooden yacht, for an intimate and unforgettable vantage point of Boston’s most spectacular maritime event of the decade. On this 90-minute cruise, you’ll depart from Rowes Wharf and glide into the harbor for up-close views of the magnificent tall ships arriving for Sail Boston® 2026.

# Why this cruise is the perfect way to enjoy the action

Patriot offers a warm, open-air design with wraparound seating and excellent sightlines from every spot on board. With her classic lines and cozy atmosphere, she brings you close to the water — an ideal platform for photos, fresh air, and relaxed conversation as the tall ships sweep past.

Skip the waterfront crowds. While the piers will be packed, you’ll be out on the harbor with unobstructed views of the ships, sails, rigging, and skyline as they move through the channel.

A full bar is available on board with beer, wine, cocktails, and snacks for purchase, making the cruise a relaxed, social way to experience the festivities with friends, family, or colleagues.

Perfectly timed viewing. Enjoy late-afternoon and early-evening light that beautifully illuminates masts, sails, hulls, and the Boston skyline — all from the comfort of a classic harbor yacht.

Avoid the land-based crowds. While the waterfront will be buzzing and congested, you’ll be on the water, moving with the action, with sweeping views of ships, harbor passages, and the Boston skyline.

With a full bar offering drinks and snacks for purchase, you can relax, mingle, and treat yourself or your guests to a premium experience in a casual, inviting setting.

Perfect timing: Enjoy “golden hour” light when the rigging, sails, and masts glow against the evening sky — and you’ll have a front-row seat for the tall-ship lineup without battling the crowds on land.

# About the Tall Ship Celebration

Sail Boston® 2026 (July 11–16, 2026) is Boston’s official participation in the global Sail250® celebration, marking the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. A fleet of majestic international tall ships and naval vessels will arrive from around the world, creating one of the most impressive maritime spectacles in the nation.

# Select Visiting Vessels

* Amerigo Vespucci – Italy
* Bluenose II – Canada
* Cisne Branco – Brazil
* Juan Sebastián de Elcano – Spain
* Esmeralda – Chile
* Dar Młodzieży – Poland
* Denis Sullivan – USA

…and many more from across the globe.

# Why This Cruise Is the Smart Ticket

Unmatched vantage point: See the tall ships without fighting shoulder-to-shoulder crowds on land.

Casual & comfortable: Patriot’s open-air layout keeps you close to the harbor action with easy movement and great visibility.

Memorable atmosphere: The combination of historic ships, warm summer breezes, harbor views, and a classic wooden yacht makes this a one-of-a-kind experience.

Relaxed & social: Perfect for groups, families, and anyone looking for a fun, refreshing way to enjoy the celebration.

Stress-free: Just come aboard, sip a drink, and enjoy the show — we take care of the rest.

## About Patriot

Patriot is a classic open-air wooden yacht operated by a licensed Coast Guard–certified captain and a friendly, knowledgeable crew. Her design offers a nostalgic New England look and provides excellent visibility around the entire vessel. With comfortable perimeter seating and a relaxed layout ideal for sightseeing, Patriot is perfectly suited for harbor tours, casual gatherings, and up-close tall ship viewing. A fully stocked bar is available on board for refreshments throughout your cruise.
